analysis.overall: You had a strong day with 90% time in range and an average glucose of 111 mg/dL, though delayed carb absorption caused spikes after meals alongside an evening low.

events.title: Late afternoon peak
events.description: After a 25g snack at 3:17 PM, glucose steadily climbed over two hours to a peak of 200 mg/dL before correction boluses brought it back down.

events.title: Post-dinner low

events.title: Overnight low stretch
events.description: Glucose drifted low around midnight, hovering in the low 60s for about an hour before gently rising back to a baseline around 80 mg/dL.

events.title: Breakfast and delayed rise
events.description: Dosed 4.8u for 60g of carbs at 8:33 AM; glucose stayed completely flat for nearly two hours before surging to 175 mg/dL late in the morning.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Carbs seem to be absorbing slowly relative to your boluses, leading to initial dips followed by late spikes—consider tracking meal timing.
